biod: Mitigate race between powerbutton and fingerprint events. Currently on devices with fingerprint overlapped on power button, behavior of the device can be unpredictable when the user presses powerbutton with an enrolled finger when on lock screen. The behavior depends on the order in which powerd and biod sees the events. ------------------------------------------------------------------------ Order of events as seen by | Current behavior | Expected behavior | biod and powerd | | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ PWRBTN DOWN, PWRBTN UP | Screen turns off | Screen turns off. | FP MATCH | an back on. | Locked. | Initial state: screen on | Unlocked. | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ PWRBTN DOWN, FP MATCH | Screen turns off | Screen turns off. | PWRBTN UP | Unlocked. | Locked. | Initial state: screen on | | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ PWRBTN DOWN, FP MATCH | Screen turns on | Screen turns on. | PWRBTN UP | Unlocked. | Locked. | Initial state: screen off | | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ FP MATCH, PWRBTN DOWN, | Screen turns off | Screen turns off. | FP MATCH | Unlocked. | Locked. | | | | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ This is a fix to address the first 3 scenarios. In this CL, we listen for power button down/up events from powerd. If we see these events in last |kAuthIgnoreTimeoutmsecs|, we assume that fp match is an side effect of user interacting with the power button. Thus we ignore the match. BUG=b:118713688 TEST=manual, deploy on nocturne and test 1 & 2 are fixed. Drop udev dependency for frecon-lite This patch expands the existing frecon-lite concept that is currently only managed by ebuilds (and the DBUS=0 command line flag) to be known within the frecon Makefiles. Code that is different between the two binaries is split into separate files with _full.c/_lite.c suffix. Also decouple frecon-lite from udev so that we can drop another big dependency from the recovery initramfs. Instead frecon-lite will simply listen to all /dev/input/eventX nodes that exist on startup. We don't really care about hotplugging for recovery, and the extra power consumption from listening to irrelevant inputs doesn't really matter for that use case. dlcservice: Install completion determined from DBus signal When update_engine signals its listeners of a status update, dlcservice is one of those listeners. Previously, dlcservice determined that update engine was done installing DLC(s) based off that fact that dlcservice held onto the DLC(s) it sent over to update_engine and that update_engine sent a status with operation IDLE.
